skill.displayName: Personalized Swimsuit – Custom Swimwear Generator Online – API-powered
skill.summary: Personalized swimsuit — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the personalized-swimsuit OpenAPI skill.
- Transforms a person photo into a bikini model image or video using input photos and optional scene descriptions.
- Supports both image and video outputs; default output is a video of the model performing a TikTok dance.
- Allows up to 16 results per request (configurable with batchCount).
- Requires a WeShop API key and HTTPS connection to openapi.weshop.ai for use.
- Includes secure authentication guidelines and endpoint usage instructions.
